reason: Make minimized summary publication and protection complete across interrupted MLflow mutations.
changes: Summary runs start with summary_complete=false and write summary_complete=true only after metrics and the minimized artifact succeed.
Matching incomplete summary runs are repaired in place on retry instead of accepted or duplicated.
Protection queries require identity, content hash, and summary_complete=true.
Protection preflights references, then writes new protected/grace state, optional old supersession, and new owner decision last so partial state blocks retention safely.
Release manifests retain the publication content hash with MLflow references.

tdd.red: tagged but incomplete summaries were returned as complete and no last-write completion seam existed
green: existing summary state distinguishes incomplete from complete
completion marker occurs only after metrics and artifact and is absent on artifact failure
preflight failure performs zero mutations and successful ordering is fail-safe
